product.description: Blackbird™ by Monoprice™8K60 Dual Function HDMI Splitter/Switch; HDMI 2.1; HDCP 2.3Share two HDMI sources with either of two displays, or simultaneously send one image to two displaysThis 8K Dual Function HDMI® Splitter/Switch allows you to switch between either of two HDMI inputs and distribute the signal to two HDMI displays. It supports HDMI video resolutions up to 8K@60Hz with the YCbCr 4:2:0 color space, as well as multichannel compressed and uncompressed audio streams. It complies with the HDMI 2.1 and HDCP™ 2.3 specifications and can deliver up to 40Gbps video bandwidth.
